mods.name: Track End Alert
mods.author: maximevincentclaudeai
mods.summary: Shows a red alert for 2 seconds when a playing track has 10, 15, 30, 45 or 60 seconds left.
mods.description:
Shows a red banner on the screen for 2 seconds when a playing track reaches the time left you chose (10, 15, 30, 45 or 60 seconds). Adds rows under Mod Menu > Community Mods: on/off, the delay and a test button.

It only reads deck state through the core's services and draws one overlay. It does not patch the deck's code, change controls or audio, or use the network.
